title: geranium pusillum var. humile
intro: Geranium pusillum var. humile, commonly known as Low Geranium or Dwarf Cranesbill, is a low-growing, herbaceous perennial plant belonging to the Geraniaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Geranium pusillum var. humile include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
